verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document an interactive API reference with runnable examples for Hoppscotch's own API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The Embed feature, which lets users embed their own requests in a web page, is an adjacent capability rather than an explorable API reference. A community report also notes you 'can't create documentation for a folder/request'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
